subject: FY24 Budget and ESSER Funds
overview: The Medford School Committee met as a Committee of the Whole to review the FY24 public schools operating budget projections, ESSER funding balances, and district priorities. The committee adopted directives requiring the superintendent to present an unconstrained budget request on May 1 and a separate gap-closing plan on May 15.

items.title: FY24 Budget Presentation and Strategic Priorities
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented the FY24 budget outlook, highlighting a projected $74 million operating need against an anticipated $71 million municipal allocation, along with expiring ESSER III funds and required staff additions. The committee approved a motion requiring the superintendent's May 1 presentation to focus exclusively on the district's unconstrained budget request, followed by an approved motion requiring a presentation on May 15 outlining plans to close the projected budget deficit.
